project.name: ifOS
project.description: Java OS (ifOS) - a microkernel operating system with both the kernel and applications implemented using the Java programming language.

layers.name: Standard Library
layers.description: Standard Java API stubs and interfaces

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: ifOS is a Java-based microkernel operating system. This step introduces the project and its high-level structure via the README.

tour.title: Core Kernel (jx.zero)
tour.description: The heart of the microkernel, implementing essential services like scheduling, synchronization, class loading, and timer management.

tour.title: Hardware Abstraction (jx.devices)
tour.description: This layer handles interaction with hardware devices. It defines a common Device interface and provides specific implementations for keyboard, screen, and PCI devices.

tour.title: Filesystem (jx.fs)
tour.description: Explore the filesystem implementation, including the hierarchy of filesystem objects and the buffer cache used to optimize disk access.

tour.title: Networking and RPC (jx.net)
tour.description: The networking stack implements IP, TCP/UDP, and Remote Procedure Call (RPC) mechanisms, along with XDR for data encoding.

tour.title: Java API Stubs (java)
tour.description: These files provide the standard Java library interfaces (like io, lang, and net) that applications use to interact with the underlying operating system.
